cards.title: Radar processing checks
cards.headline: median slope 0.9994 over 97 pairs
cards.sentence: Our radar processing matches the provider's own maps (slope 1.00). The airport reference reads zero, lakes are masked, and there are no unwrapping jumps.

cards.title: Do the radar patterns repeat? (Sentinel-1, 2021–23 → 2024–25)
cards.headline: Block ρ 0.306, κ 0.138, skill -0.24
cards.baseline: Zero-motion baseline error 0.381 cm vs model 0.424 cm
cards.sentence: Ground moves within about 1 cm of the airport pad each summer, and which areas move more did not repeat reliably between years. So radar can't yet tell stable from degrading ground here.

posthoc.title: Post-hoc variant (ramp removed)
posthoc.headline: Block ρ 0.516
posthoc.note: Chosen after the official test failed; reported, not used for the official result.

cards.title: Does NISAR agree with Sentinel-1? (2026)
cards.headline: Block ρ 0.009
cards.sentence: NISAR's first summer over Tuk didn't produce a usable series: one pair failed to unwrap and several lost coherence. Its few usable pairs show no agreement.

cards.title: Predicting ground where radar can't see
cards.headline: 110 degrading examples (needs 300)
cards.sentence: Not run: radar found too few examples of degrading ground to learn from, so no predicted layer is shown.

cards.title: Shoreline forecast (fit 1985–2004, predict 2005–2025)
cards.headline: Forecast error 48.2 m vs no-change 13.8 m
cards.sentence: The 30 m satellite waterline is too noisy to project a trend, so arrival years are hidden. Measured change since 2005 is shown instead.

cards.title: Reindeer Point consistency
cards.headline: 0.0 of measured cells degrading
cards.baseline: Public reports of sinking homes (Canadian Geographic, Oct 2026)
cards.sentence: Homes sit on gravel pads. At 80 m, radar can't separate pad settling from ground thaw, so this is not a test of the reports.

deviations.what: Training years 2021-2023 instead of 2018-2023; min_seasons 3 instead of 4
deviations.why: Sentinel-1 2018-2020 were never processed by HyP3 (no Earthdata access overnight); only three training summers exist

deviations.what: Thaw onset from air temperature only
deviations.why: Station snow depth reports 3-4 cm in late June at 14 C daily mean; judged unusable on training data

deviations.what: Computation on the shared EPSG:4326 grid with distances and blocks from UTM 8N cell coordinates
deviations.why: Part 1 and Part 2 rasters are on the shared grid; every distance is still in metres

deviations.what: Confidence c_fit floor uses tau instead of 2*sigma_ref
deviations.why: Motion is referenced to the airport, so sigma_ref is ~0 and the spec formula would give zero confidence to every stable cell

deviations.what: Test B uses NISAR sensitivity from 12-day increments; the class comparison (kappa) is not available
deviations.why: The 2026 NISAR chain breaks (24 Aug-5 Sep pair failed to unwrap; several pairs lost coherence), so no cell has the five connected dates the class rules need
NISAR 2026 has no connected series of three or more passes over most of the area

deviations.what: Model C uses the satellite waterline 1985-2025; hindcast fits <= 2004 and predicts 2005-2025 (spec: air photos 1947-1985 fit)
deviations.why: Automatic air-photo shorelines failed visual review (traced mosaic edges and an inner harbour); decided before any hindcast error was seen

deviations.what: Sentinel-1 2022 to mid-2025 cover only the northern half of the area (town); the highway corridor has 2021 and 2025 only
deviations.why: HyP3 products for those dates were single-frame; corridor cells fall back to short-record rules

limits: Motion is relative to a reference area (airport gravel pad)
A screen for where to look, not a sign-off
